headline: Benchmarks now test single-cell and sequencing analysis tools head-to-head
label: Benchmarked Sequencing Analysis Pipelines
summary: Explicit comparisons against alternatives under defined metrics are increasingly reported alongside pipeline-only papers in transcriptomic and sequencing…
synthesis: The dominant thread in this set is benchmarking of analysis workflows against alternatives under defined metrics. The strongest examples are a systematic comparison of four commercial long-read snRNA-seq workflows (10x 3' and 5', ArgenTag, Parse) on Nanopore data, assessing read length and isoform resolution, and a benchmark of seven ambient RNA decontamination tools for scRNA-seq that evaluates contamination estimation accuracy, robustness, and subtype sensitivity. NanoCutSight similarly benchmarks its nanopore pipeline across guide RNAs for quantifying indel percentages at a target locus. Other items are pipelines, QC tools, or resources rather than head-to-head tests: EISCA and EISTA nf-core pipelines for scRNA-seq and imaging-based spatial transcriptomics, SingleCellMQC for multi-omics quality control, pyXLMS for crosslinking mass spectrometry, spatialMET for mass spectrometry imaging metabolomics, PalmLab for palmitoylation annotation, and an expanded TheCellVision imaging repository. What is new is the explicit testing against alternatives, which distinguishes these reports from pipeline-only papers.
